Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

FIG. I SPATULA, PLASTICS, CLEAR AND COLOURLESS, DENTAL 



3. Material — Clear arid colourless acrylic plastics. 

4. Requirements 

4*1 The spatula shall be free of cracks, scratches, pits and sharp edeges^ 

4.2 The surface of the spatulSt shall be sufficiently hard to vyithstand the abrasion v/hlle mixing silicate 
cements wUh orthophosphoric acid. 

4*3 The spatula shall not be flexible. 

5. Marliing — Mark with manufacturer's name. Initials or recognized trade-mark and the country of 
manufacture. 

5.1 ISI Certification Morkmg — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution, 

6. Packing — Wrap In wax paper or put in polyethylene bag and then pack In cartons In accordance with 
the trade practice or the packing may be done as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
